purpose: Demo presentation effects and resumable scene/service sequencing: common runner and four wrappers, composing the accepted demo interpreter and persistent actor renderer. This is not the gameplay session or all pixel/audio services.

inputs: Named run/reveal/pre-game/attract/completion entry; a per-run typed cursor. Fresh fade level/step, exit word and water surface at each event cut; captured palette work, keyboard change/scan word, completion carry and joystick-zero result at immediate post-service cuts.
Effect inputs are raw sprite/level and raw X32. All scalar word patterns, signed/wrapping boundaries, flags and histories are broad; no initialized fade/timer positivity restriction.
outputs: One ordered named service, global store, vector selection, reveal X reset, outer-loop repeat or terminal action. Every action and next phase is consumed/checked by the retained ABI shell.
Effects return triggered fade/level writes or pixel/word/byte reveal-width results, including retained high byte.
effects: Initialize executes its real initial interpreter step/callbacks before runner clears exit/fade and polls input. Every service yields to the real callee before a fresh projection; no eager stale frame plan.

Palette/retrace/page, water draw, keyboard/joystick and near/far music are synchronous services. Native requests decide their order/selection and semantic music arguments; actual return frames and all machine outputs remain in the bridge.
Draw/erase use the accepted actor_render entries. Demo-core initialization/advance/completion remain their accepted services, including explicit compatibility for synthetic/unregistered streams.
preconditions: Ordinary disjoint RAM, resources, target width byte, stack and native inputs/outputs; no asynchronous mutation between declared service points. Services may mutate fresh globals at cuts. Normal returns preserve their stated caller segment/stack bindings; abnormal/nonlocal prefixes admit arbitrary returned registers, including CS/DS/SS:SP.
Bridge admits canonical DS/CS and valid even effect actor index<32; other bindings retain the checked literal shell. Native kind/phase identifies an admitted entry or continuation cut.

Script/header/pixel/audio resources and index/prefix admission belong to their existing service owners. No corruption or device-alias safety is invented. Normal whole-game scenarios have zero new-component compatibility.

Renderer histories remain persistent across modes. New code does not clear/project/rederive any actor cache. The original 100000-iteration diagnostic guard remains in the literal runner; formal properties are one-step/branch composition, not arbitrary-demo termination.

callers: Menu/startup/post-game and RunGameFromPassword call the four wrappers; the pre-game return word/flags are ignored by the actual session prefix.
Demo-core stored callbacks call the two effects or the distinct IgnoreActorState. All28 registered headers and four vectors are checked; loc_0B4E is not a callback.

indirect.classification: Complete stored callback set decoded from all28 immutable registered headers. Named service enums bind exact near targets and the two far music targets/argument frames in the bridge. Pregame/completion retain tail transfers, attract retains direct call, reveal retains near call plus cleanup.

owned: Common runner: DemoExitCode, ScreenFadeLevel and ScreenFadeStep ordered word effects. Reveal wrapper: slot0 ActorX32 explicit reset.
Fade callback: level/step conditional writes. Reveal callback: exactly one byte through the original mutable far pointer, with original DI direction/wrap.
borrowed: Current actor sprite/raw X for callbacks; current global fade/water/input/completion state and captured service results.
Demo resources, actor histories and mode controls keep accepted owners. Normal caller/near/far stack scratch is retained, not abstracted away from compiled comparisons.
memory.aliases: No PassengerStoneSlot scratch alias is read or widened. Effects borrow presentation outputs/raw position; the native scene sequence does not serialize actor slots or inactive aliases.
memory.projection: Native cursor and captured input snapshot agree with each actual service continuation. Pending service and normal terminal action consumption are checked. Service-mutated RAM is reprojected before the next event; palette result uses returned work, not a stale fade-level reconstruction.

assumptions: B uses literal source partitions and branch-stage equality seams. Shared arbitrary service register/status/global results ground complete output comparisons, all private captured-result fields and next phases; no service implementation model substitutes for the retained service contract.

Word-normalized ordinary disjoint RAM and stack, fixed selected-effect-slot normalization and a single arbitrary event-index observer plus total event count. Compiled corpus varies all16 effect indices and all small boundary domains.

Native frame/dependence are independent properties over actual next code. Output profiles cover full machine register/flag words, every declared RAM/stack word, ordered stores/calls/arguments/return words, normal completion and abnormal prefixes.

Outer diagnostic guard and complete ABI shells are checked retained code; real services/callbacks, IRQ inputs and whole-run composition have independent L0 C/D evidence. No universal lifetime disjointness, dead-register claim or stronger status is inferred.
eliminated: Native code has no registers/flags, RAM accessors, original addresses, segment arithmetic, dispatch or return-stack representation. Named events and captured semantic service results replace the machine orchestration.
No synthetic callback role, AX boolean return or unconditional reveal cleanup normalization is introduced.
retained: Signed fade-level and surface thresholds, palette equality256, surface equality192, wrapping fade steps/levels and fresh service-mutated RAM. Negative fade returns flags from memory TEST of exit code; AX remains the real working value.

Completion CF bypasses input. Idle joystick ZF selects keyboard. AH==0 continues before fade scheduling; low scan is masked7F. Q->FFFF, Escape->1, other changes/button->0. Existing negative fade step is never restarted.

Pre-game wrapper tail-calls the common runner; caller proceeds to score/level initialization independently of returned AX/SF/ZF. Attract uses direct call and completion retains music-stop/start before its vector/tail.

Reveal saves common-runner flags, clears slot0 X32, calls width cleanup, then restores those flags. Width SAR5 and signed upper AL-only clamp preserve AH, have no lower clamp and can wrap the byte/far offset with DF.
Initial callback effects precede runner exit/fade clears. Renderer cache lifetimes and all16 histories remain owned by accepted services; no new mode switch clears.

Independent actual native frame/dependence and two full effect properties cover remaining state. Four full wrappers are source-checked; after-prepare/music/cleanup/return profiles cover their continuations. Draw/erase delegate to accepted actor_render. No monolithic arbitrary-session termination or pixel/audio-service proof is claimed.
